methods.label: Factor out the common monomial
methods.explanation: The greatest common divisor of the coefficients \(6\) and \(9\) is \(3\), and the common variables with their lowest powers give \(ab\), so the common factor is \(3ab\). After factoring it out, \(6a^2b\div3ab=2a\) and \(9ab^2\div3ab=3b\).
